author: ADDITION
notes: No cheats yet: find them with the Scanner while you play. Good first targets: Gold (i32, shown in the gear menu; spend some at a shop and scan again), Health (f32; take a hit, scan Decreased) and Talent Points (i32). Unreal Engine games usually give a pointer path from HogwartsLegacy.exe that survives restarts. Steam starts a small launcher with the same name; ADDITION attaches to the real game.
